text: The user asked to commit the whole .yolo-twice folder, so the assistant checked tracked, on-disk and ignored files and found all of them already tracked, with five modified since the last commit because a running engine (cli.ts start on port 9656) keeps updating the index. It committed them as a8871de "Refresh .yolo-twice index" and left the tree clean without pushing. The commit succeeded, and the assistant warned that the folder will keep changing until that engine is stopped with `bun run cli stop`.
